summary: Three Bedroom Home · Wonderful Garden · Spacious Living Room · Central Ashington
description:
My Property Box introduce to the Lettings market this wonderful three bedroom family home on St. Andrews Terrace, Ashington. Ideally situated in the heart of Ashington, the spacious property is ideal for a couple or family who desire a home with a modern yet homely feel. Great access to the A189, A1 as well as surrounding areas such as Northumberland and the coast. Briefly comprising; entrance through a modern kitchen leading into a large living room with French doors to the rear garden as well as family bathroom. To the first floor are three bedrooms, all with fitted wardrobes.

To arrange your viewing, contact MPB and speak to the Lettings Team.
